description: Implementation of a service class 'StuckJobExecutorServiceImpl' that manages restarting and handling stuck batch jobs, including partitioned jobs, within the Fineract project.

classes.name: StuckJobExecutorServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class responsible for detecting and restarting stuck jobs, including partitioned jobs, in the Fineract batch processing system.

methods.name: resumeStuckJob
methods.description: Main method to resume a stuck job by job name, handling partitioned and tasklet jobs accordingly.

methods.name: restartTaskletJobs
methods.description: Restarts a list of tasklet jobs by their IDs.

methods.name: handleStuckTaskletJob
methods.description: Attempts to restart a specific tasklet job by its ID.

methods.name: restartPartitionedJobs
methods.description: Restarts partitioned jobs by handling each stuck partitioned job ID.

methods.name: isPartitionedJob
methods.description: Checks if a given job name corresponds to a partitioned job.

methods.name: getPartitionerStepName
methods.description: Retrieves the partitioner step name for a given job name.

methods.name: areThereStuckJobs
methods.description: Checks if there are any stuck jobs for a given job name.

methods.name: getStuckJobIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of stuck jobs for a given job name.

methods.name: handleStuckPartitionedJob
methods.description: Handles a stuck partitioned job by waiting for partitions, marking job as failed, and restarting.

methods.name: waitUntilAllPartitionsFinished
methods.description: Waits until all partitions of a job are completed.

methods.name: areAllPartitionsCompleted
methods.description: Checks if all partitions of a job are completed.
